# Combined 243-state candidate

This binary single-tape machine has **243 working states**, including initialization, and one separate halt state. It starts in state0 at head0 on an all-zero two-way infinite tape; every transition moves left or right. It combines the [loop-rotation244](../candidate-rotation244/README.md) source/decoder change with the [compensated244](../candidate-compensated244/README.md) local fold. The resulting ordinary argument supports **ZFC ⊢ (¬Halt(M243) ↔ Con(ZFC))**. This table was developed in the repository after reviewing the two deliveries; neither incoming ZIP supplied it.

Starting from the exact Routing245 inherited table, delete old26 and122 and apply seven retained-row changes:12/0,12/1,17/1 for QT;92/1,104/1,106/1,167/1 for compensation. The patches commute as literal edits and leave486 total binary rows,479 retained rows unchanged, and no target to either removed label. Literal disjointness alone would not prove semantic preservation.

The [ordinary comparison](proof/ordinary-comparison.md) checks every hypothesis needed to reuse the compensation proof with rotated244 as the old machine: the same local tape invariant, all required incoming edges, all seven whole-tape block identities, the ordinary-row classification and excluded endpoint controls. None of those local calculations uses deleted26 or the changed12/17 actions. Positive finite block durations then preserve halting from shared old start95 at every head and arbitrary tape. Composing with the QT source/runtime/seed proof gives the ordinary blank-tape consistency calibration. This does not assume the old routed245 and QT244 tapes agree at every intermediate step.

The source remains QT's6,459-leaf,8,390-case program. Root's separate [quick verification](evidence/quick-verification.json) passes all8,390 affine cases, all8,390 finite literal fixtures totaling **6,473,394 transitions**, and a newly computed complete blank prefix of **407,967 transitions**. The entire root frame agrees with the predecessor: old dispatcher96, head−5, marker−6, header176, span181, logical values `(3,0,0,0,3,0,0,0,0)`,167 spare ones and351 one-cells, zero elsewhere. The startup count comes from this actual run, not by adding the two predecessors' time differences.

At this publication proposal, complete expanded runtime and relative Lean comparison are **pending separate actual records**. The quick record explicitly excludes those conclusions. A relative binary Lean halting theorem, if subsequently checked, would still need the rotated machine's calibrated source bridge before it became a complete243 consistency endpoint. The full internal [PA calibration](../pa_internalization.md) remains open. The currently closed [compensated244 external endpoint](../compensated244_binary.md) is a different exact artifact.
